_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Daily Shift Log
summary: The Daily Shift Log documents contractor effort and work accomplished during a shift, including items needing attention by the next shift or the Government POC.
use_relationship:
The Daily Shift Log displays the contractors' effort towards achieving contract objectives. It is a log of work accomplished during the applicable shift. The Log includes any information or tasks that may need to be addressed by the next shift or the Government point of contact (POC), and any additional data that is requested.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Daily Shift Log shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Daily Shift Log shall contain the following:

children.title: Names of contractor personnel on shift.
Log of telephone, email, or in person contacts made to external organizations.
Security check verification
children.content: indicating that applicable classified material handling security checks have been accomplished, if classified material has been accessed or is stored in the work area, or if Secure Internet Protocol Router Network (SIPRNet) workstations or printers are present and utilized. If no classified material, SIPRNet workstations, or SIPRNet printers are present, this section of the Log shall be marked as not applicable (N/A).

children.title: Date and time of event(s)
children.content: to include: highlights of the past shift, work tempo and completion, anomalies in data, issues, contacts from ports, Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES) outages and requests for manual manifesting assistance, Customs and Border Patrol passenger vetting, and Department of Homeland Security contagious disease passenger screening.

children.title: Meeting minutes from any meetings throughout the day
A description of significant events that took place
Decisions made (e.g., motions made, votes, etc.)
Positive or negative impacts to the Remote Manifesting Resolution Center (RMRC) operations
Any recommendations for the Government regarding meeting events
